title: Correspondance complète et autres écrits de Guy Patin
author: Guy Patin
institution: Bibliothèque interuniversitaire de santé / Université Paris Cité (Numérabilis); edited by Loïc Capron
notes: Annotated critical edition of the letters of the Paris physician Guy Patin to colleagues in France, Switzerland, Germany and the Low Countries, with indexes of people, places and terms, a full-text search and printing options. Count: 1,079 letters, the sum of the per-year totals on the edition's date index (1630 to 1673); words not given. The site shows '4e édition (mai 2022) revue et augmentée' as its latest update and no later change was found, hence archived. Letters are open without login.
